notes: Unity draws into one SurfaceView, so uiautomator sees nothing: every tap here is
computed from a real RectTransform, never estimated.
Canvas 1242x2688, ScreenMatchMode Expand, panels under an AspectRatioFitter locked
to 1242/2688. On a 1080x2400 device the canvas resolves to 1242x2760 and the panel
keeps a 36-unit letterbox, so x = panelX / 1242 and y = (36 + 2688 - panelY) / 2760.
Every element is pinned to a POINT anchor by the prefab builder, so a panel centre
is simply its anchoredPosition and no anchor arithmetic is needed.
The board is 1025 units wide at centre (621, 1370), cell 205, so cell (col,row) sits
at (621 + (col-2)*205, 1370 + (2-row)*205). Step 3 taps cell (1,2), dead centre of a
Step 1 and the PLAY step block on the loader instead of waiting a fixed time: the
menu scene shows the template SplashPanel on cold launch (FirstAnimationTime 85),
and the game scene shows its own on arrival, so a fixed wait would photograph the
loading bar and push every later tap onto the wrong screen.
Each step changes the screen for a different reason: 02 loads a scene, 03 lights the
row+column cross and the four arrows, 04 and 05 slide five tiles each along
different axes and move the counter, 06 pops the rabbit and drops HINT 3 to HINT 2,
07 covers the board with the pause card.
